usage: agent-reach [-h] [-v] [--version] {setup,install,configure,doctor,uninstall,skill,format,transcribe,check-update,watch,version} ...

Give your AI Agent eyes to see the entire internet

positional arguments:
  {setup,install,configure,doctor,uninstall,skill,format,transcribe,check-update,watch,version}
                        Available commands
    setup               Interactive configuration wizard
    install             One-shot installer with flags
    configure           Set a config value or auto-extract from browser
    doctor              Check platform availability
    uninstall           Remove all Agent Reach config, tokens, and skill files
    skill               Manage agent skill registration
    format              Clean and format platform API output
    transcribe          Transcribe a URL or local audio file (Whisper via Groq/OpenAI)
    check-update        Check for new versions and changes
    watch               Quick health check + update check (for scheduled tasks)
    version             Show version

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose         Show debug logs
  --version             show program's version number and exit
